methods.throughput: Count of clean plotted request/job starts divided by the elapsed span to the last start, including recorded startup. Puma throughput chart values are the published requests/s, not the SPA ten-second request counts.
methods.latency: Puma: median queueing in each ten-second window and across all measured queueing observations. Queueing times are end-aligned to the request timeline, matching the report latency-stack alignment. Sidekiq: processing p99 in each ten-second window; whole-run p99 copied from the published clean per-job percentile curve. No averaging of window percentiles for headline metrics.
methods.threads: Puma live spawned pool; Sidekiq recorded pool. Fixed Puma pools use their measured fixed count and recorded run span.
methods.phases: Changing-workload I/O-heavy windows copied from the adaptive report. Baseline runs keep their own elapsed-time axes and completion times; phases are not stretched to align.
methods.capacity: Not measured. Any process-count estimate is derived from the throughput ratio.
